LanguageData.Rimblings.Description: Pawns speak when they start social interactions. Zoom and distance control what you hear.
LanguageData.Rimblings.SectionSpeechDesc: Choose whose voices play and how they sound.
LanguageData.Rimblings.SectionHearingDesc: Voices fade as you zoom out or move the camera away.
LanguageData.Rimblings.SectionMixingDesc: Control how voices share the mix when pawns speak at once.
LanguageData.Rimblings.EnabledDesc: Turn all Rimblings voices on or off.
LanguageData.Rimblings.FullZoomDesc: Voices play at full zoom-based volume at or below this camera size. Smaller sizes mean a closer view.
LanguageData.Rimblings.SilentZoomDesc: Voices fade to silence by this camera size. It must be larger than the full-volume size.
LanguageData.Rimblings.HearingRadiusDesc: Voices outside this distance are silent, even off-screen.
LanguageData.Rimblings.Ducking: Background voices when a speaker is focused
LanguageData.Rimblings.DuckingDesc: Set how loud other voices remain when one pawn is focused.
LanguageData.Rimblings.MaxVoicesDesc: Extra overlapping voices may be skipped at this cap.
LanguageData.Rimblings.LimitVoicesDesc: Leave off for no simultaneous voice cap.
LanguageData.Rimblings.NonPlayerDesc: Also hear visitors, raiders and other humanlike pawns.
LanguageData.Rimblings.ShortenWordsDesc: Use each word's first and last letters for shorter speech.
LanguageData.Rimblings.HideVoiceEditor: Hide Voice Editor from the toolbar
LanguageData.Rimblings.HideVoiceEditorDesc: Hide the Voice Editor button. Existing custom voices keep working. Turn this off to show the button again.
LanguageData.Rimblings.EditorSaveHelp: Preview changes, then save the voice to apply them. Save the game afterward to keep them. Loading an earlier save restores its voices.
LanguageData.Rimblings.EditorUnavailable: Open a colony to edit pawn voices.
LanguageData.Rimblings.EditorSearch: Search your colony's colonists by name, including those on other maps or travelling in caravans. Temporary quest guests are excluded.
LanguageData.Rimblings.EditorShortVoiceDesc: Use each word's first and last letters for shorter speech. Applies immediately to all pawn voices and previews.
LanguageData.Rimblings.EditorSelectPawn: Select a pawn to edit their voice.
LanguageData.Rimblings.EditorPitchDesc: Lower values produce a lower voice; higher values produce a higher voice.
LanguageData.Rimblings.EditorDepthDesc: Add bass weight and soften higher frequencies without changing pitch or speaking speed. Zero keeps the original tone.
LanguageData.Rimblings.EditorSpeedDesc: Change the pawn's speaking cadence. Normal speech also follows game speed; previews play at normal game speed.
LanguageData.Rimblings.EditorPhrase1: This is what I sound like.
LanguageData.Rimblings.EditorPhrase2: Hello there! Welcome to our colony.
LanguageData.Rimblings.EditorPreviewFailed: Preview could not play. Check Rimblings speech volume, game volume, and that the voice-bank files are installed.
LanguageData.Rimblings.EditorApplied: Voice applied. Save the game to retain this change.
LanguageData.Rimblings.EditorDiscardDesc: This pawn has unapplied voice changes. Discard them?
